{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CcrsGgwxpaR6LfjBQf2Mt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01HxxjKh1KuDP95TzBEVospq","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 -c \"\nimport pandas as pd, collections\ndf = pd.read_csv('dataset/hospital_compensation_registry.csv')\nbyid = df.set_index('patient_id')\n# undirected adjacency\nadj=collections.defaultdict(set)\nfor _,r in df.iterrows():\n    ec=r['emergency_contact_patient_id']\n    if pd.notna(ec) and ec in byid.index:\n        adj[r['patient_id']].add(ec); adj[ec].add(r['patient_id'])\n\ndef bfs(src):\n    dist={src:0}; q=[src]\n    while q:\n        nq=[]\n        for u in q:\n            for v in adj[u]:\n                if v not in dist: dist[v]=dist[u]+1; nq.append(v)\n        q=nq\n    return dist\n\nfor surname,filer in [('Quill','PAT_265'),('Rivera','PAT_033'),('Jones','PAT_006')]:\n    d=bfs(filer)\n    fam=df[(df['second_name']==surname)&(df['patient_id']!=filer)]\n    print(f'=== {surname} family, distance to filer {filer} ===')\n    recs=[]\n    for _,r in fam.iterrows():\n        recs.append((d.get(r['patient_id'],99), r['patient_id'], r['full_name'], 'NOCLAIM' if pd.isna(r['record_date']) else r['compensation_reason']))\n    for dd,pid,name,cl in sorted(recs):\n        print(f'  dist={dd}  {pid} {name:16} {cl}')\n    print()\n\"\n","description":"Shortest-path distance from filers to same-surname relatives"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3965,"cache_read_input_tokens":40459,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":3965,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"63539f93-9609-4102-8d7a-60574a422914","uuid":"5adf3d71-3d8b-4331-aed6-1a57fec50898","request_id":"req_011CcrsGfTvFTWVhnxLqeDck"}
